_comment: Single source of truth for the pilot (ds.md C1). The notebook, sweep, ledger payloads and certificates MUST read these values; tests/compliance_verification_tests.py asserts consistency.

model.quantisation: 4-bit NF4 (bitsandbytes) on GPU, bf16 CPU fallback

data.author_cluster_method: deterministic row blocks of qa_per_author (see src/tofu_data.py)
data.provenance_note: data/synthetic_fixture_*.json are schema fixtures for unit tests only, NOT the benchmark (ds.md F2/A7).

privacy.accounting: opacus RDP when available, else explicit Gaussian-mechanism accounting recorded per run

audit.bootstrap: author-clustered, 1000 replicates, alpha 0.05 (Proposal Sec 5.4, ds.md A6)

certificate.signing: HMAC-SHA-256 with key_id (src/cert_signer.py); key from env UNLEARNING_CERT_HMAC_KEY, never committed (ds.md A5/F5)
certificate.evidence_policy: certificates are built ONLY from results/*.json produced by real runs (ds.md A4/F4)
